plan.goal: Evaluate the usability, clarity, and safety of the MeadowID identity dashboard, focusing on the primary security workflows (Connected Apps, Active Sessions) and critical recovery actions (Freeze, Export).
plan.summary: The exploration will proceed from the Overview dashboard into high-risk management pages: Connected Apps (token revocation), Active Sessions (session termination), and Passkeys/2FA. It will conclude with destructive/recovery flows like Data Export and Account Freezing to validate confirmation patterns and user guidance.
assumptions: The site is a static local demo; form submissions (e.g., 'Add passkey', 'Export data') will likely result in UI state changes or mock success messages rather than backend processing.
Navigation relies heavily on the left sidebar, which persists across all pages.
Mobile viewport checks are critical due to prescan warnings regarding small tap targets (40px height vs 44px standard).
risk_hotspots: connected-apps.html: Revoke button (destructive action requiring confirmation)
devices.html: End session / Review unfamiliar location (security critical)
freeze.html: Account freeze toggle (high consequence, needs clear undo path)
Global Sidebar: Tap target sizes on mobile (accessibility/usability risk)

phases.title: Dashboard & Triage
phases.objective: Validate the Overview page's ability to surface security issues and guide users to resolution.
key_checks: Verify visibility of 'Things to look at' alerts (unfamiliar session, weak factor).
Test 'Run security check' button behavior.
Check navigation links from alert cards (e.g., 'Review' -> devices.html, 'Add passkey' -> passkeys.html).
Inspect 'Recovery readiness' checklist for clarity.

phases.title: Token & Session Management
phases.objective: Assess the clarity and safety of revoking app access and terminating active sessions.
key_checks: Filter/Search functionality in Connected Apps.
Click 'Revoke' on an app: Verify confirmation modal/dialog appears before action.
In Active Sessions, identify the 'unfamiliar location' warning.
Test 'End all other sessions' button.
Verify visual distinction between current device and remote devices.
exit_criteria: Confirmation dialogs present for destructive actions.
Session list clearly distinguishes trusted vs. untrusted devices.

phases.title: Authentication & Recovery Factors
phases.objective: Evaluate the management of passkeys, 2FA methods, and backup codes.
key_checks: List existing passkeys and hardware keys.
Test 'Add a passkey' flow (mocked).
Check 'Reveal & download' for backup codes (should require re-auth or clear warning).
Verify SMS vs. Authenticator app risk messaging.
Test Recovery Email verification input field.
exit_criteria: Clear distinction between primary factors (passkeys) and backup factors (SMS/Codes).
Sensitive actions (revealing codes) have appropriate friction.

phases.title: Data Portability & Nuclear Options
phases.objective: Validate the complexity and clarity of exporting data and freezing the account.
key_checks: Walk through Data Export steps: Select categories -> Format -> Schedule.
Verify estimated file sizes are shown for transparency.
On Freeze page, read 'What freezing does' vs 'does not do' copy.
Test the Freeze switch/toggle: Check for immediate confirmation or delay.
Verify 'Request deletion' link availability.
exit_criteria: Export flow feels transparent regarding what data is included.
Freeze action clearly communicates reversibility and impact.

phases.title: Mobile Responsiveness & Accessibility
phases.objective: Repeat critical path checks on mobile viewport to address prescan tap-target warnings.
key_checks: Verify sidebar navigation usability (hamburger menu or scrollable list?).
Check tap targets for 'Revoke' and 'End Session' buttons (prescan flagged <44px).
Ensure tables/lists (Sign-ins, Apps) remain readable on narrow screens.
Verify no horizontal scrolling breaks layout.
exit_criteria: Critical controls are tappable without zooming.

coverage_targets.pages: Visit all 6 HTML files identified in prescan.
coverage_targets.features: Exercise all 'Revoke', 'End Session', 'Add Passkey', and 'Freeze' controls.
coverage_targets.mobile: Full regression of Phases 1, 2, and 4 on mobile viewport.

notes: Prescan indicates 'small_tap_target' warnings on almost all nav items (40px height). Prioritize checking if these are actually difficult to hit on mobile despite being visually small.
Since this is a local demo, expect 'Add Passkey' to fail or show a mock error if browser WebAuthn APIs aren't fully supported in the test environment; document the fallback UX.
Pay attention to the 'Trust Score' logic on the dashboard—does it update when actions are taken?

prescan_summary.title: Freeze account — MeadowID
prescan_summary.visible_text_excerpt: MeadowID ◐ Overview ⇄ Connected apps ▢ Active sessions ⌘ Passkeys & 2FA ↓ Export your data ❄ Freeze account JT Jamal Tarrant jamal@thirdpond.dev Freeze account A freeze is the strongest, reversible version of "stop everything." We use it for incidents. It is not the same as deleting your account. What freezing does Every connected app is signed out and rejected until you unfreeze. New tokens cannot be issued. Sign-ins are blocked from every device. You'll need your password and a passkey or backup code to unfreeze. Subscriptions, automatic backups, and recurring data exports are paused. Your data is not deleted. Nothing is shared with apps. You stay billed only if a free trial is converting. What freezing does not do It does not remove sessions on third-party servers that don't honor token revocation (extremely rare; we report these). It does not freeze accounts you opened with email/pas
